modelo-visor.elementoVisual: A simple, illustrative scene or texture, rendered with soft shadows and warm neutral tones, fills the main visual area. This element metaphorically represents the subject being 'adjusted' or 'focused on', directly relating to the hero sentence.
composicoes: The hero text is large and centered, with a subtle visual element filling the background, slightly desaturated.
The hero text is aligned to the top left, with a prominent visual element occupying the bottom two-thirds of the post.
A large, abstract visual element dominates the left side, with the hero text stacked vertically on the right, using ample negative space.
The hero text is positioned in the bottom third, with a full-bleed, subtly textured visual element above it, suggesting a 'before' or 'after' state.
The hero text is split into two lines, with the first line large and top-aligned, and the second line smaller and bottom-aligned, framing a central, focused visual element.
modelo-visor.tipografia: Titles use a strong, clean geometric sans-serif in medium to bold weights, with a distinct lowercase 'l'. Supporting text and numerical elements use a wide-tracked monospaced sans-serif, often in uppercase, for a technical, precise feel. Hierarchy is established through size and weight.
modelo-visor.textura: Surfaces are smooth, with a subtle, dark, translucent glass-like overlay that creates depth, allowing the background visual element to show through softly.
modelo-visor.luz: The scene is lit with soft, diffused light, creating gentle shadows and a sense of depth without harsh contrasts.
modelo-visor.papeisDasCores: A dark background dominates, with light text for readability. A single, cool accent color is used sparingly for emphasis or to highlight key elements.
modelo-visor.evitar: Do not add any glow effects, letter outlines, emojis, colorful gradients, camera shake, full white flashes, or 'REC' indicators. Avoid any elements that suggest a fake or overly decorated interface.

modelo-wireframe.atmosfera: Precise, measured, and calm, evoking a professional design review environment.
modelo-wireframe.elementoVisual: A stylized, flat illustration or graphic representation of the subject matter, rendered within the mobile phone screen or a design frame. This element evolves from a minimalist wireframe sketch with placeholder shapes to a clean, fully rendered graphic using the brand's palette. The 'comment pin' shape, where the presenter would be, is filled with a related abstract texture or a close-up detail of the subject, maintaining the flat, graphic style.
composicoes: Hero text is large and centered, with a wireframe mobile phone or design frame on the left, showing a subject-related graphic. The 'comment pin' shape is in the upper right.
Hero text is aligned to the top left, with a large, clean page graphic filling the right two-thirds of the post. The 'comment pin' shape is in the bottom left.
Hero text is small and bottom-aligned, with a full-bleed wireframe graphic of the subject occupying most of the canvas. The 'comment pin' shape is in the upper right.

Hero text is vertically stacked on the left, with a split layout showing a wireframe graphic on the left half and a clean page graphic on the right half. The 'comment pin' shape is in the upper right.
Hero text is integrated into a large, clean page graphic that fills the entire post, with the 'comment pin' shape subtly placed as an accent in one corner.
modelo-wireframe.tipografia: A clear, legible sans-serif for interface elements and titles, with a distinct 'I' and 'l' to avoid confusion. A monospaced font is used for measurements and numerical data, while a high-contrast serif is reserved for key promises or brand statements. Hierarchy is established through size and weight, with titles being large and text remaining highly readable.
modelo-wireframe.textura: A dark background with a subtle grid of light points, mimicking a design canvas. Surfaces are flat and clean, with no visible grain or paper texture, emphasizing digital precision.
modelo-wireframe.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a soft, diffused light, creating minimal shadows and maintaining a clean, technical aesthetic.
modelo-wireframe.papeisDasCores: The dark background dominates, with light text for readability. A single accent color is used for revision marks and to highlight resolved elements, while the brand's primary color fills the 'clean page' elements.
modelo-wireframe.evitar: Do not include any glowing effects, neon, gradients, spinning 3D mockups, or emojis. Avoid any real or fake UI elements like logos, browser bars, or toolbars that are not part of the core design canvas aesthetic. Do not use any color other than the designated accent for revision marks.

modelo-yap.atmosfera: Professional and direct, this style conveys information clearly and soberly. It feels modern and trustworthy, suitable for educational or financial content.
modelo-yap.elementoVisual: A stylized, flat graphic illustration or a clean product photograph fills the card-like shapes. The visual element directly represents the subject of the hero sentence, rendered with a slightly soft, rounded aesthetic.
composicoes: The hero text is centered at the bottom, with a large illustrative card filling the top two-thirds of the post.
The hero text is aligned left in the middle, with a smaller illustrative card positioned to the right, leaving ample negative space.
A large illustrative card occupies the entire background, with the hero text overlaid in the lower center, highlighted by a subtle accent strip.
The hero text is large and centered, with a small, square illustrative card placed in the upper left corner, acting as an emblem.
The hero text is split into two lines, left-aligned at the top, with a prominent illustrative card filling the bottom half of the post.
modelo-yap.tipografia: A wide, geometric sans-serif typeface, like Plus Jakarta Sans, is used throughout. Key words in the hero text are rendered in a bold, heavy weight, while supporting text uses a medium weight, all in uppercase or title case with normal tracking.
modelo-yap.textura: Surfaces are smooth and clean, resembling matte paper or a soft digital render. Subtle, soft shadows give depth to card elements.
modelo-yap.luz: The scene is evenly lit with a soft, diffused light, creating gentle shadows and maintaining a bright, clear appearance.
modelo-yap.papeisDasCores: The background is a light, warm tone, with dark text for primary information and a single, vibrant accent color used sparingly for highlights and underlines.
modelo-yap.evitar: Do not use any filters, vignettes, blur, or color overlays on images. Avoid text with outlines, more than one accent color, or any elements that shake, spin, or flash.
